install:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

echo '=== Installing system dependencies ==='

# Update package lists
sudo apt-get update

# Install Python 3.11 and development tools
sudo apt-get install -y \
  python3.11 \
  python3.11-dev \
  python3.11-venv \
  python3-pip \
  python3-setuptools \
  build-essential

# Install MariaDB
sudo apt-get install -y \
  mariadb-server \
  mariadb-client \
  libmariadb-dev

# Install Redis
sudo apt-get install -y redis-server

# Install other dependencies
sudo apt-get install -y \
  git \
  curl \
  wget \
  fontconfig \
  libssl-dev \
  libffi-dev \
  libxml2-dev \
  libxslt1-dev \
  zlib1g-dev \
  libsasl2-dev \
  libldap2-dev \
  libcups2-dev \
  pango1.0-tests \
  libpango-1.0-0 \
  libpangocairo-1.0-0

# Install Node.js 18 (LTS)
curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_18.x | sudo -E bash -
sudo apt-get install -y nodejs

# Install Yarn
sudo npm install -g yarn

# Install wkhtmltopdf (for PDF generation)
cd /tmp
wget -q https://github.com/wkhtmltopdf/packaging/releases/download/0.12.6.1-2/wkhtmltox_0.12.6.1-2.jammy_amd64.deb
sudo apt-get install -y /tmp/wkhtmltox_0.12.6.1-2.jammy_amd64.deb || true
rm -f /tmp/wkhtmltox_0.12.6.1-2.jammy_amd64.deb

echo '=== Configuring MariaDB ==='

# Start MariaDB
sudo systemctl start mariadb
sudo systemctl enable mariadb

# Configure MariaDB for Frappe
sudo mysql -e "SET GLOBAL innodb_file_format=Barracuda;"
sudo mysql -e "SET GLOBAL innodb_file_per_table=1;"
sudo mysql -e "SET GLOBAL innodb_large_prefix=1;"
sudo mysql -e "SET GLOBAL character_set_server=utf8mb4;"
sudo mysql -e "SET GLOBAL collation_server=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;"

# Create MariaDB config for Frappe
sudo tee /etc/mysql/mariadb.conf.d/frappe.cnf > /dev/null <<'MARIADB_EOF'
[mysqld]
character-set-client-handshake = FALSE
character-set-server = utf8mb4
collation-server = utf8mb4_unicode_ci

[mysql]
default-character-set = utf8mb4
MARIADB_EOF

# Restart MariaDB to apply configuration
sudo systemctl restart mariadb

echo '=== Configuring Redis ==='

# Start Redis
sudo systemctl start redis-server
sudo systemctl enable redis-server

echo '=== Installing Frappe Bench ==='

# Upgrade pip for ubuntu user
python3.11 -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel

# Install frappe-bench
python3.11 -m pip install frappe-bench

echo '=== Initializing Frappe Bench ==='

cd /home/ubuntu

# Initialize bench with Frappe v16 and Python 3.11
bench init frappe-bench \
  --frappe-branch version-16 \
  --python python3.11 \
  --verbose

cd /home/ubuntu/frappe-bench

echo '=== Getting ERPNext ==='

# Get ERPNext v16
bench get-app erpnext --branch version-16 --skip-assets

echo '=== Creating development site ==='

# Create a new site with default credentials
bench new-site development.localhost \
  --db-root-password admin \
  --admin-password admin \
  --no-mariadb-socket

echo '=== Installing ERPNext on site ==='

# Install ERPNext on the site
bench --site development.localhost install-app erpnext

echo '=== Setting up Logistics app ==='

# Create symlink from /workspace to bench apps directory
ln -sf /workspace /home/ubuntu/frappe-bench/apps/logistics

# Install logistics app dependencies
cd /home/ubuntu/frappe-bench
/home/ubuntu/frappe-bench/env/bin/pip install -e apps/logistics

# Install logistics app on the site
bench --site development.localhost install-app logistics

echo '=== Building assets ==='

# Build frontend assets
bench build --app logistics

echo '=== Setup complete ==='
echo 'Frappe bench location: /home/ubuntu/frappe-bench'
echo 'Site: development.localhost'
echo 'Admin username: Administrator'
echo 'Admin password: admin'
echo ''
echo 'To start the development server:'
echo '  cd /home/ubuntu/frappe-bench'
echo '  bench start'
start:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Ensure services are running
sudo systemctl start mariadb || true
sudo systemctl start redis-server || true

echo 'Frappe bench is ready at /home/ubuntu/frappe-bench'
echo 'To start the development server:'
echo '  cd /home/ubuntu/frappe-bench'
echo '  bench start'
